name: South Palms Resort & Spa Panglao
short_description: A 188-room MGallery beachfront resort in a coconut grove on Panglao Island, Bohol, five minutes from Bohol-Panglao International Airport.
ai_summary: South Palms Resort & Spa Panglao - MGallery Collection opened on 8 August 2025 as Panglao Island's first internationally branded luxury resort, set in a coconut grove on a private white-sand beach roughly five minutes from Bohol-Panglao International Airport and a short ride from Alona Beach's bars and dive shops. The 188-room resort leans into Boholano design and culture, with reclaimed local wood and tilework in the rooms, four dining venues built around farm-to-table and regional Filipino cooking, and an on-site South Farm supplying the kitchens. It's part of the wider Panglao Shores sustainability initiative. Early reviews praise the design, beach, spacious rooms, and attentive staff, with guests split on whether the rates are worth it -- some call it pricey, others say the quality justifies the cost.

pros: 188 rooms and suites in a coconut-grove beachfront setting, opened August 2025 as Panglao's first internationally branded luxury resort
Wide, powdery-white private beach with abundant daybeds and loungers, per guest reviews
Four dining venues spanning farm-to-table Boholano cuisine (UMA), Mediterranean pizzeria (Manja) and heritage-style Filipino dining (Tiya's House)
On-site South Farm and cultural experiences (M Moment) rooted in Boholano traditions
About five minutes from Bohol-Panglao International Airport, with Alona Beach's bars and dive shops a short ride away
cons: Rates run high relative to older, independent resorts on Panglao Island, and some reviewers call it pricey for the location
As a newly opened property (August 2025), some amenities such as the spa were still being finished around launch
research_highlights: An August 2025 feature (Damn Good Travels) detailed the design-forward architecture, farm-to-table dining, and cultural M Moment experience shortly after opening
Room count (188) and the 8 August 2025 opening date are confirmed consistently across trade press (Hospitality Net, TTR Weekly) and the official MGallery site
TripAdvisor shows a strong reception with roughly 795 reviews and a #1 ranking among hotels in Tawala, Panglao, as of research
research_watchouts: Coverage found is concentrated around the property's August 2025 opening -- guest experience may have evolved as the resort has matured through its first year
Some sources note the on-site spa was still being completed at launch; current spa status wasn't independently re-verified beyond the opening-period coverage

faqs.question: When did South Palms Resort & Spa Panglao - MGallery Collection open?
faqs.answer: It opened on 8 August 2025 as Panglao Island's first internationally branded luxury resort, with 188 rooms and suites set in a coconut grove on a private white-sand beach. It's part of the wider Panglao Shores sustainability development on the island.

faqs.question: How far is South Palms Resort & Spa Panglao from the airport and Alona Beach?
faqs.answer: The resort is about five minutes from Bohol-Panglao International Airport, making it one of the more airport-convenient resorts on the island, and a short ride from Alona Beach's concentration of bars, dive shops and restaurants, which remain the island's main nightlife and activity hub.
